senses.definition: a spirit who is believed to be a servant of God, and is sent by God to deliver a message or perform a task. Angels are often shown dressed in white, with wings.

examples.x: a host of angels

senses.definition_vi: một thực thể tinh thần được tin là tôi tớ của Chúa, và được Chúa sai đến để truyền tin hoặc thực hiện một nhiệm vụ. Thiên thần thường được miêu tả mặc đồ trắng, có cánh.

senses.definition: a person who is very good and kind; a child who behaves well

examples.x: John is no angel, believe me (= he does not behave well).
Mary’s children are little angels.
I could hardly see Lisa in the role of ministering angel.

senses.definition_vi: một người rất tốt bụng và tử tế; một đứa trẻ cư xử tốt

senses.definition: used when you are talking to somebody and you are grateful to them

examples.x: Thanks Dad, you're an angel.
Be an angel and make me a cup of coffee.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng khi bạn đang nói chuyện với ai đó và bạn biết ơn họ

senses.definition: a person who supports a business by investing money in it, especially somebody who supports a new small business with their own money

examples.x: When will the angels get their money back?
They started the business with the help of $2 million supplied by angel investors.

senses.definition_vi: một người hỗ trợ một doanh nghiệp bằng cách đầu tư tiền vào đó, đặc biệt là người hỗ trợ một doanh nghiệp nhỏ mới bằng tiền của mình

senses.definition: people with little experience try to do the difficult or dangerous things that more experienced people would not consider doing
senses.definition_vi: những người có ít kinh nghiệm cố gắng làm những việc khó khăn hoặc nguy hiểm mà những người có kinh nghiệm hơn sẽ không xem xét làm

senses.definition: having a rank below that of a senior person and helping them in their work

examples.x: the assistant manager/director/commissioner
She is an assistant professor of psychology at Ohio State University.
Assistant Chief Constable Owen
Assistant Attorney General William Weld
a former assistant Secretary of State
an assistant coach/editor

senses.definition_vi: có cấp bậc dưới người cấp cao và giúp đỡ họ trong công việc

senses.definition: to make a connection between people or things in your mind

examples.x: I always associate the smell of baking with my childhood.
He is closely associated in the public mind with horror movies.
Most people immediately associate addictions with drugs and alcohol.
You wouldn’t normally associate these two writers—their styles are completely different.

senses.definition_vi: kết nối hai người hoặc hai vật với nhau trong tâm trí bạn

senses.definition: to spend time with somebody, especially a person or people that somebody else does not approve of

examples.x: I don't like you associating with those people.

senses.definition_vi: dành thời gian với ai đó, đặc biệt là một người hoặc những người mà người khác không chấp thuận

senses.definition: to show that you support or agree with something

examples.x: I associate myself with the prime minister's remarks (= I agree with them).
I have never associated myself with political extremism.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện rằng bạn ủng hộ hoặc đồng ý với điều gì đó

senses.definition: if one thing is associated with another, the two things are connected because they happen together or one thing causes the other

examples.x: the risks associated with taking drugs
Exposure to the sun is strongly associated with an increase in the incidence of skin cancer.
The conference will address the broad issues associated with E-commerce.
The following factors were significantly associated with chronic fatigue.
Lack of confidence is not something normally associated with a high-flying sales executive.
Salaries and associated costs have risen substantially.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một thứ gì đó liên quan đến thứ khác, thì hai thứ đó có kết nối vì chúng xảy ra cùng nhau hoặc một thứ gây ra thứ kia

senses.definition: if a person is associated with an organization, etc. they support it

examples.x: He no longer wished to be associated with the party's policy on education.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một người liên kết với một tổ chức, v.v., họ ủng hộ nó

senses.definition: used in the name of a business company that is made up of a number of smaller companies

examples.x: Associated British Foods

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong tên của một công ty kinh doanh bao gồm một số công ty nhỏ hơn

senses.definition: an official group of people who have joined together for a particular purpose

examples.x: Do you belong to any professional or trade associations?
a residents’ association
The association meets/meet four times a year.

senses.definition_vi: một nhóm chính thức gồm những người đã cùng nhau vì một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: a connection or relationship between people or organizations

examples.x: They have maintained a close association with a college in the US.
his alleged association with terrorist groups
She became famous through her association with the group of poets.
The book was published in association with (= together with) English Heritage.
The competition was organized in association with the Government's anti-drugs initiative.
The letter was a clumsy attempt to establish guilt by association.

senses.definition_vi: một sự kết nối hoặc mối quan hệ giữa mọi người hoặc các tổ chức

senses.definition: an idea or a memory that is suggested by somebody/something; a mental connection between ideas

examples.x: The seaside had all sorts of pleasant associations with childhood holidays for me.
The cat soon made the association between human beings and food.
Incense always had associations with religion for him.

senses.definition_vi: một ý tưởng hoặc một ký ức được gợi ý bởi ai đó/điều gì đó; một kết nối tinh thần giữa các ý tưởng

senses.definition: a connection between things where one is caused by the other

examples.x: Studies have shown strong associations between housing conditions and health.
a proven association between passive smoking and cancer
The study found a significant association between exposure to electromagnetic fields and the disease.
cases of cancer found in association with colitis

senses.definition_vi: một mối liên hệ giữa các sự vật, trong đó một sự vật gây ra sự vật kia

senses.definition: to come together, or bring people together, in one place to form a group

examples.x: A crowd soon gathered.
His supporters gathered in the main square.
Can you all gather round? I've got something to tell you.
The whole family gathered together at Ray's home.
They were all gathered round the TV.
A large crowd was gathered outside the studio.
The kids were gathered together in one room.

senses.definition_vi: tập hợp lại, hoặc đưa mọi người lại với nhau, ở một nơi để tạo thành một nhóm

senses.definition: to bring things together that have been spread around

examples.x: People slowly gathered their belongings and left the hall.
I waited while he gathered up his papers.
She gathered her things together and got to her feet.

senses.definition_vi: gom những thứ đã bị phân tán lại với nhau

senses.definition: to collect information from different sources

examples.x: to gather information/data/intelligence
Detectives have spent months gathering evidence.

senses.definition_vi: thu thập thông tin từ các nguồn khác nhau

senses.definition: to collect plants, fruit, etc. from a wide area

examples.x: to gather wild flowers
They lived in the forest, gathering mushrooms and berries to eat.

senses.definition_vi: thu thập thực vật, trái cây, v.v. từ một khu vực rộng lớn

senses.definition: to pick or cut and collect crops to be stored

examples.x: It was late August and the harvest had been safely gathered in.

senses.definition_vi: nhổ hoặc cắt và thu hoạch mùa màng để lưu trữ

senses.definition: to believe or understand that something is true because of information or evidence you have

examples.x: I gather (that) you wanted to see me.
I gather from your email that you're not enjoying your job.
‘There's been a delay.’ ‘I gathered that.’
‘She won't be coming.’ ‘So I gather.’
You're self-employed, I gather.
As far as I can gather, he got involved in a fight.
From what I can gather, there's been some kind of problem.

senses.definition_vi: tin hoặc hiểu rằng điều gì đó là đúng vì thông tin hoặc bằng chứng bạn có

senses.definition: to increase in speed, force, etc.

examples.x: The truck gathered speed.
During the 1980s the green movement gathered momentum.
Thousands of these machines are gathering dust (= not being used) in stockrooms.
As the weeks passed, Charlotte began to gather strength.

senses.definition_vi: tăng tốc độ, lực, v.v.

senses.definition: to gradually increase in number or amount

examples.x: The storm clouds were gathering.
the gathering gloom of a winter’s afternoon

senses.definition_vi: dần dần tăng về số lượng hoặc khối lượng

senses.definition: to pull a piece of clothing tighter to your body

examples.x: He gathered his cloak around him.
She gathered up her skirts and ran.

senses.definition_vi: kéo một mảnh quần áo lại gần cơ thể bạn hơn

senses.definition: to pull parts of a piece of clothing together in folds and sew them in place

examples.x: She wore a skirt gathered (in) at the waist.

senses.definition_vi: kéo các bộ phận của một mảnh quần áo lại với nhau thành nếp gấp và khâu chúng lại

senses.definition: to pull somebody towards you and put your arms around them

examples.x: She gathered the child in her arms and held him close.
He gathered her to him.
I gathered her close and kissed her.

senses.definition_vi: kéo ai đó về phía bạn và vòng tay ôm lấy họ

senses.definition: to prepare yourself to do something that requires effort

examples.x: I sat down for a moment to gather my strength.
She was still trying to gather her thoughts together when the door opened.
Fortunately the short delay gave him time to gather himself.

senses.definition_vi: chuẩn bị bản thân để làm điều gì đó đòi hỏi nỗ lực

senses.definition: to get your breath back after an effort

examples.x: He paused to gather his breath.

senses.definition_vi: lấy lại hơi thở sau một nỗ lực

senses.definition: to not be used for a long time

examples.x: That guitar's been sitting there gathering dust for years now.
Play your guitar that's gathering dust, or pull out the old tennis racket for a match.
You may already have an old laptop that is collecting dust but otherwise usable.

senses.definition_vi: không được sử dụng trong một thời gian dài

senses.definition: a person who moves from place to place, job to job, etc. does not have a lot of money, possessions or friends but is free from responsibilities
senses.definition_vi: một người di chuyển từ nơi này sang nơi khác, công việc này sang công việc khác, v.v. không có nhiều tiền, tài sản hoặc bạn bè nhưng được tự do khỏi trách nhiệm

senses.definition: a meeting of people for a particular purpose

examples.x: a social/family gathering
He was asked to speak at a gathering of religious leaders.

senses.definition_vi: một cuộc họp của mọi người vì một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: the process of collecting something

examples.x: methods of information gathering

senses.definition_vi: quá trình thu thập một cái gì đó

senses.definition: sexually or romantically attracted to people of the same sex

examples.x: gay men/women
a gay actor/politician/activist
She's gay.

senses.definition_vi: bị hấp dẫn tình dục hoặc lãng mạn với người cùng giới

senses.definition: connected with people who are gay

examples.x: a gay club/bar
the lesbian and gay community
the gay and lesbian section in the bookstore

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến những người đồng tính

senses.definition: (used especially by young people) an offensive way to describe something you find boring, stupid or not attractive
senses.definition_vi: (đặc biệt được sử dụng bởi người trẻ) một cách xúc phạm để mô tả một cái gì đó bạn thấy nhàm chán, ngu ngốc hoặc không hấp dẫn

senses.definition: happy and full of fun

examples.x: gay laughter
She felt lighthearted and gay.

senses.definition_vi: hạnh phúc và đầy niềm vui

senses.definition: brightly coloured

examples.x: The garden was gay with red geraniums.

senses.definition_vi: màu sắc tươi sáng

senses.definition: without thinking about the results or effects of a particular action
senses.definition_vi: không suy nghĩ về kết quả hoặc tác động của một hành động cụ thể

senses.definition: giving or willing to give freely; given freely

examples.x: The gallery was named after its most generous benefactor.
a generous donation/gift/offer
You've been incredibly generous with your time.
He was generous to his friends and family.
She was generous in her praise for her co-stars.
They were very generous in giving help
Thank you for your donation. It was very generous of you.

examples.cf: it is generous of somebody to do something
examples.x: It was extremely generous of him to offer to pay for us both.

senses.definition_vi: cho đi hoặc sẵn sàng cho đi một cách tự do; được cho đi một cách tự do

senses.definition: more than is necessary; large

examples.x: a generous helping of meat
The car has a generous amount of space.
The review panel criticized the payments as overly generous.

senses.definition_vi: nhiều hơn mức cần thiết; lớn

senses.definition: kind in the way you treat people; willing to see what is good about somebody/something

examples.x: a generous mind
He wrote a very generous assessment of my work.
Her generous spirit shone through in everything she did.

senses.definition_vi: tốt bụng trong cách bạn đối xử với mọi người; sẵn lòng nhìn thấy điều tốt đẹp ở ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: unusually great intelligence, skill or artistic ability

examples.x: the genius of Shakespeare
a statesman of genius
Her idea was a stroke of genius.

senses.definition_vi: trí thông minh, kỹ năng hoặc khả năng nghệ thuật phi thường

senses.definition: a person who is unusually intelligent or artistic, or who has a very high level of skill, especially in one area

examples.x: a mathematical/comic, etc. genius
He's a genius at organizing people.
You don't have to be a genius to see that they are in love!

senses.definition_vi: một người có trí thông minh hoặc nghệ thuật phi thường, hoặc có kỹ năng rất cao, đặc biệt là trong một lĩnh vực

senses.definition: a special skill or ability

examples.x: He had a genius for making people feel at home.

senses.definition_vi: một kỹ năng hoặc khả năng đặc biệt

senses.definition: a person or spirit who is thought to have a good/bad influence over you
senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc linh hồn được cho là có ảnh hưởng tốt/xấu đến bạn

senses.definition: calm and kind; doing things in a quiet and careful way

examples.x: a kind and gentle man
Terry was a gentle soul.
He looks scary but he's really a gentle giant.
She was the gentlest of nurses.
a gentle voice/laugh/touch
a gentle reminder that your next payment is due on Friday
He lived in a gentler age than ours.
Be gentle with her!

senses.definition_vi: bình tĩnh và tốt bụng; làm mọi việc một cách lặng lẽ và cẩn thận

senses.definition: not strong or extreme

examples.x: a gentle breeze
the gentle swell of the sea
Cook over a gentle heat.

senses.definition_vi: không mạnh hoặc cực đoan

senses.definition: having only a small effect; not strong or violent

examples.x: We went for a gentle stroll.
The doctor recommended a little gentle exercise.
This soap is very gentle on the hands.

senses.definition_vi: chỉ có tác dụng nhỏ; không mạnh hoặc bạo lực

senses.definition: not steep or sharp

examples.x: a gentle slope/curve

senses.definition_vi: không dốc hoặc sắc

senses.definition: a man who is polite and well educated, who has excellent manners and always behaves well

examples.x: You acted like a true gentleman.
Thank you—you're a real gentleman.
He was always the perfect gentleman.
He's no gentleman!
He was too much of a gentleman to ask them for any money.

senses.definition_vi: một người đàn ông lịch sự và có học thức, có phong thái tuyệt vời và luôn cư xử đúng mực

senses.definition: used to address or refer to a man, especially somebody you do not know

examples.x: Ladies and gentlemen! Can I have your attention, please?
She was talking to an elderly gentleman.
Ladies and gentlemen of the jury!
Can I help you, gentlemen?
There's a gentleman to see you.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để xưng hô hoặc đề cập đến một người đàn ông, đặc biệt là người bạn không quen biết

senses.definition: used to address or refer to a male member of a legislature, for example the House of Representatives
senses.definition_vi: dùng để xưng hô hoặc đề cập đến một thành viên nam của cơ quan lập pháp, ví dụ như Hạ viện

senses.definition: a man from a high social class, especially one who does not need to work

examples.x: He retired to his estate and lived the life of a country gentleman.
a gentleman farmer (= one who owns a farm for pleasure, not as his main job)

senses.definition_vi: một người đàn ông thuộc tầng lớp xã hội cao, đặc biệt là người không cần làm việc

senses.definition: a man/woman who does not have to work
senses.definition_vi: một người đàn ông/phụ nữ không phải làm việc

senses.definition: real; exactly what it appears to be; not artificial

examples.x: Is the painting a genuine Picasso?
Fake designer watches are sold at a fraction of the price of the genuine article.
She is a genuine contender for the title.
The document is not considered genuine.

senses.definition_vi: thật; chính xác những gì nó thể hiện; không giả tạo

senses.definition: sincere and honest; that can be trusted

examples.x: He made a genuine attempt to improve conditions.
She always showed genuine concern for others.
He came across as a very genuine person.

senses.definition_vi: chân thành và trung thực; đáng tin cậy

senses.definition: a movement that you make with your hands, your head or your face to show a particular meaning

examples.x: He made a rude gesture at the driver of the other car.
She finished what she had to say with a gesture of despair.
They communicated entirely by gesture.

senses.definition_vi: một chuyển động bạn thực hiện bằng tay, đầu hoặc mặt để thể hiện một ý nghĩa cụ thể

senses.definition: something that you do or say to show a particular feeling or intention

examples.x: They sent some flowers as a gesture of sympathy to the parents of the child.
It was a nice gesture (= it was kind) to invite his wife too.
We do not accept responsibility but we will refund the money as a gesture of goodwill.
His speech was at least a gesture towards improving relations between the two countries.
The government has made a gesture towards public opinion (= has tried to do something that the public will like).

senses.definition_vi: một điều bạn làm hoặc nói để thể hiện một cảm xúc hoặc ý định cụ thể

senses.definition: a female child

examples.x: a little girl of six
a six-year-old girl
a baby/young/teenage girl
a beautiful/clever girl
When I was a girl, I wanted to be a dancer.
Hello, girls and boys!

senses.definition_vi: một đứa trẻ nữ

senses.definition: a daughter

examples.x: They have two girls and a boy.
Our youngest girl is at college.

senses.definition_vi: một người con gái

senses.definition: a young woman

examples.x: He married the girl next door.
It's a great way to meet girls.
Alex is not interested in girls yet.

senses.definition_vi: một phụ nữ trẻ

senses.definition: the women in a group

examples.x: I'm having a night out with the girls.
Good morning, girls!

senses.definition_vi: những người phụ nữ trong một nhóm

senses.definition: a girlfriend

examples.x: He’s taking his girl home to meet his parents.

senses.definition_vi: một bạn gái

senses.definition: a female worker

examples.x: an office girl

senses.definition_vi: một nữ công nhân

senses.definition: an offensive term for a weak man, who is not brave or confident
senses.definition_vi: một thuật ngữ xúc phạm dành cho một người đàn ông yếu đuối, không dũng cảm hoặc tự tin

senses.definition: a girl or a woman that somebody is having a romantic relationship with

examples.x: He’s got a new girlfriend.
I ran into a former girlfriend at the party.

senses.definition_vi: một cô gái hoặc một phụ nữ mà ai đó đang có mối quan hệ lãng mạn

senses.definition: a female friend

examples.x: I had lunch with a girlfriend.

senses.definition_vi: một người bạn nữ

senses.definition: pleased; happy

examples.x: ‘I passed the test!’ ‘I’m so glad.’
She was glad when the meeting was over.
‘He doesn't need the pills any more.’ ‘I'm glad about that.’
I'm glad to hear you're feeling better.
I’m glad (that) you’re feeling better.
He was glad he'd come.
I'm just glad you’re safe!
I've never been so glad to see anyone in my life!
I'm glad to meet you. I've heard a lot about you.
He talked so much that they were really glad to see the back of him (= when he left).
I'm so glad for him because he's such a nice lad.

senses.definition_vi: hài lòng; hạnh phúc

senses.definition: grateful for something

examples.x: She was very glad of her warm coat in the biting wind.
I'd be glad of your help.
She was secretly glad of his company.
I'd be glad if you could help me.

senses.definition_vi: biết ơn vì điều gì đó

senses.definition: very willing to do something

examples.x: I'd be glad to lend you the money.
If you'd like me to help you, I'd be only too glad to.

senses.definition_vi: rất sẵn lòng làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: bringing joy; full of joy

examples.x: glad tidings
They greeted each other with glad cries.

senses.definition_vi: mang lại niềm vui; đầy niềm vui

senses.definition: used when you are commenting on a situation and saying that you are happy about it

examples.x: Most teachers, I'm glad to say, take their jobs very seriously.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang nhận xét về một tình huống và nói rằng bạn hài lòng về nó

senses.definition: the quality of being good

examples.x: the essential goodness of human nature
evidence of God’s goodness
At least have the goodness (= good manners) to look at me when I'm talking to you.
We like to think that goodness exists in everyone.

senses.definition_vi: phẩm chất tốt

senses.definition: the part of something that has a useful effect on somebody/something, especially somebody’s health

examples.x: These vegetables have had all the goodness boiled out of them.
Branches pruned from the trees are shredded so the goodness goes back into the soil.

senses.definition_vi: phần của một cái gì đó có tác dụng hữu ích đối với ai đó/điều gì đó, đặc biệt là sức khỏe của ai đó

senses.definition: used to emphasize that you do not know something

examples.x: God knows what else they might find.
‘Where are they?’ ‘Goodness knows.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn không biết điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to emphasize the truth of what you are saying

examples.x: She ought to pass the exam—goodness knows she's been working hard enough.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh sự thật của những gì bạn đang nói

senses.definition: used to express surprise

examples.x: Goodness, what a big balloon!
My goodness, you have been busy!
Goodness me, no!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để bày tỏ sự ngạc nhiên

senses.definition: having or showing strong feelings of sexual love or of anger, etc.

examples.x: to have a passionate nature

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc thể hiện những cảm xúc mạnh mẽ về tình yêu tình dục hoặc sự tức giận, v.v.

senses.definition: having or showing strong feelings of enthusiasm for something or belief in something

examples.x: a passionate interest in music
a passionate defender of civil liberties

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc thể hiện những cảm xúc mạnh mẽ về sự nhiệt tình đối với một cái gì đó hoặc niềm tin vào một cái gì đó.

senses.definition: a person who is the same age or who has the same social status as you

examples.x: She enjoys the respect of her peers.
A peer review system is being introduced to help teachers who are experiencing difficulty.
Children are worried about failing in front of their peers.
Peer pressure is strong among young people (= they want to be like other people of the same age).

senses.definition_vi: một người cùng tuổi hoặc có cùng địa vị xã hội với bạn

senses.definition: (in the UK) a member of the nobility or the House of Lords

examples.x: MPs and peers from all parties met to discuss the issue.

senses.definition_vi: (ở Vương quốc Anh) một thành viên của giới quý tộc hoặc Hạ viện

senses.definition: human beings; men, women and children

examples.x: At least ten people were killed in the crash.
There were a lot of people at the party.
Many young people are out of work.
older people
They are just ordinary people.
Millions of working people are struggling.
It is important to involve local people in the project.
poor/rich people
people of faith (= people who are religious)

senses.definition_vi: con người; đàn ông, phụ nữ và trẻ em

senses.definition: humans in general; everyone

examples.x: We want to change the way people think.
People want fresh, local food.
He wanted to help people fulfil their potential.
She tends to annoy people.

senses.definition_vi: con người nói chung; mọi người

senses.definition: all the people who live in a particular place or belong to a particular country, ethnic group, etc.

examples.x: the American/French people
black/white people
the indigenous peoples of Mexico

senses.definition_vi: tất cả những người sống ở một địa điểm cụ thể hoặc thuộc về một quốc gia, nhóm dân tộc, v.v.

senses.definition: men and women who work in a particular type of job or are involved in a particular area of activity

examples.x: a meeting with business people and bankers
These garments are intended for professional sports people.

senses.definition_vi: đàn ông và phụ nữ làm việc trong một loại công việc cụ thể hoặc tham gia vào một lĩnh vực hoạt động cụ thể

senses.definition: the ordinary citizens of a country rather than those who govern or have a special position in society

examples.x: the life of the common people
It was felt that the government was no longer in touch with the people.

senses.definition_vi: những công dân bình thường của một quốc gia thay vì những người cai trị hoặc có vị trí đặc biệt trong xã hội

senses.definition: the men, women and children that a person leads

examples.x: The king urged his people to prepare for war.
the story of the Zulu leader who died while attempting to free his people

senses.definition_vi: những người đàn ông, phụ nữ và trẻ em mà một người lãnh đạo

senses.definition: the men and women who work for you or support you

examples.x: I've had my people watching the house for a few days.
Our people are all highly trained and motivated.

senses.definition_vi: những người đàn ông và phụ nữ làm việc cho bạn hoặc ủng hộ bạn

senses.definition: guests or friends

examples.x: I'm having people to dinner this evening.

senses.definition_vi: khách hoặc bạn bè

senses.definition: the men, women and children that you are closely related to, especially your parents, grandparents, etc.

examples.x: She's spending the holidays with her people.

senses.definition_vi: những người đàn ông, phụ nữ và trẻ em mà bạn có quan hệ mật thiết, đặc biệt là cha mẹ, ông bà, v.v.

senses.definition: to please everyone by changing your attitudes or opinions to suit different people
senses.definition_vi: làm hài lòng mọi người bằng cách thay đổi thái độ hoặc ý kiến của bạn để phù hợp với những người khác nhau

senses.definition: to be understood or used in different ways by different people
senses.definition_vi: được hiểu hoặc sử dụng theo những cách khác nhau bởi những người khác nhau

senses.definition: a man/woman who understands and supports ordinary people

examples.x: He is not only a statesman, but also a man of the people.

senses.definition_vi: một người đàn ông/phụ nữ hiểu và ủng hộ những người bình thường

senses.definition: when you say of all people, you are emphasizing that somebody is the person you would most or least expect to do something

examples.x: She of all people should know the answer to that.

senses.definition_vi: khi bạn nói ‘of all people’, bạn đang nhấn mạnh rằng ai đó là người bạn mong đợi hoặc ít mong đợi nhất sẽ làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: you should not criticize other people, because they will easily find ways of criticizing you
senses.definition_vi: bạn không nên chỉ trích người khác, vì họ sẽ dễ dàng tìm ra cách chỉ trích bạn

senses.definition: a human as an individual

examples.x: What sort of person would do a thing like that?
He's a fascinating person.
What is she like as a person?
He's just the person we need for the job.
She's the only person I can talk to about my problems.
Gary was the last person I expected to see when I answered the doorbell.
I had a letter from the people who used to live next door.
I'm not really a city person (= I don't really like cities).

senses.definition_vi: một con người với tư cách là một cá nhân

senses.definition: a human, especially one who is not identified

examples.x: A certain person (= somebody that I do not wish to name) told me about it.
The price is $40 per person.
This vehicle is licensed to carry 4 persons. (= in a notice)
The verdict was murder by a person or persons unknown.
The virus is spread from person to person.

senses.definition_vi: một con người, đặc biệt là người không được xác định

senses.definition: a person working in the area of business mentioned; a person connected with the thing mentioned

examples.x: a salesperson
a spokesperson

senses.definition_vi: một người làm việc trong lĩnh vực kinh doanh được đề cập; một người có liên quan đến điều được đề cập

senses.definition: any of the three classes of personal pronouns. The first person (I/we) refers to the person(s) speaking; the second person (you) refers to the person(s) spoken to; the third person (he/she/it/they) refers to the person(s) or thing(s) spoken about.
senses.definition_vi: bất kỳ trong ba loại đại từ nhân xưng. Ngôi thứ nhất (tôi/chúng tôi) chỉ người nói; ngôi thứ hai (bạn) chỉ người được nói đến; ngôi thứ ba (anh ấy/cô ấy/nó/họ) chỉ người hoặc vật được nói đến.

senses.definition: if you have or carry something about/on your person, you carry it about with you, for example in your pocket

examples.x: Relatives of the dead man were traced through an address found on his person.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn có hoặc mang theo thứ gì đó bên mình, bạn mang nó theo mình, ví dụ trong túi của bạn

senses.definition: to treat everyone in the same way, without being influenced by their importance, wealth, etc.

examples.x: Death is no respecter of persons.

senses.definition_vi: đối xử với mọi người như nhau, không bị ảnh hưởng bởi tầm quan trọng, sự giàu có, v.v. của họ

senses.definition: if you do something in person, you go somewhere and do it yourself, instead of doing it by letter, asking somebody else to do it, etc.

examples.x: You have to pick up the package in person.
She appeared in person to collect her prize.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn làm điều gì đó trực tiếp, bạn đến một nơi nào đó và tự mình làm, thay vì làm bằng thư, nhờ người khác làm, v.v.

senses.definition: in the form or shape of somebody

examples.x: Help arrived in the person of his mother.
The firm has an important asset in the person of the sales director.

senses.definition_vi: có hình dạng hoặc hình thức của ai đó

senses.definition: a person who is believed to be involved in a crime, but who has not been arrested

examples.x: Police have said they do have a person of interest in the case.

senses.definition_vi: một người được cho là có liên quan đến một tội phạm, nhưng chưa bị bắt

senses.definition: your own; not belonging to or connected with anyone else

examples.x: The novel is written from personal experience.
a personal account of her experiences
personal effects/belongings/possessions
I take personal responsibility for the incident.
Of course, this is just a personal opinion.
a personal preference/view
Her art is deeply personal.
intensely/highly personal
I need my own personal space.
The software is for personal use only (= no one else can use it).

senses.definition_vi: của riêng bạn; không thuộc về hoặc liên quan đến bất kỳ ai khác

senses.definition: between individual people who know each other

examples.x: Having good personal relationships is the most important thing for me.
She is a personal friend of mine.

senses.definition_vi: giữa những người quen biết nhau

senses.definition: connected with a person’s private life, rather than their job or official position

examples.x: I try not to let work interfere with my personal life.
personal information/data/details (= information about you that not everyone can know)
The letter was marked ‘Personal’.
I'd like to talk to you about a personal matter.
Please keep personal phone calls to a minimum.
I'd rather not talk about it, it's personal.
He moved to San Francisco for personal reasons.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến đời sống riêng tư của một người thay vì công việc hoặc vị trí chính thức của họ

senses.definition: done by a particular person rather than by somebody who is acting for them

examples.x: The President made a personal appearance at the event.
I shall give the matter my personal attention.
She takes a personal interest in the work of the charity.
The Principal has little personal contact with the students.

senses.definition_vi: do một người cụ thể thực hiện thay vì do người đại diện cho họ

senses.definition: made or done for a particular person rather than for a large group of people or people in general

examples.x: We offer a personal service to all our customers.
a personal pension plan (= a pension organized by a private company for one particular person)
Will you do it for me as a personal favour?

senses.definition_vi: được tạo ra hoặc thực hiện cho một người cụ thể thay vì cho một nhóm lớn người hoặc mọi người nói chung

senses.definition: referring to a particular person’s character, appearance, opinions, etc. in a way that is offensive

examples.x: Try to avoid making personal remarks.
I felt the criticism crossed the line and became a personal attack.
Then he got personal and brought my family into it.
It's nothing personal (= I do not wish to offend you) but I have to correct you on that point.

senses.definition_vi: ám chỉ đến tính cách, ngoại hình, ý kiến, v.v. của một người cụ thể theo cách xúc phạm

senses.definition: connected with a person’s body

examples.x: personal cleanliness/hygiene
She's always worrying about her personal appearance.
This insurance policy covers you against personal injury or death.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến cơ thể của một người

senses.definition: physically very close to somebody; getting to know them well

examples.x: Get up close and personal with the koalas at the San Diego Zoo.
For the last 30 years, I’ve been up close and personal with people whose lives were in crisis.

senses.definition_vi: rất gần gũi về thể chất với ai đó; tìm hiểu kỹ về họ

senses.definition: the various aspects of a person’s character that combine to make them different from other people

examples.x: His wife has a strong personality.
My outgoing personality has definitely helped me succeed.
He maintained order by sheer force of personality.
normal human personality traits (= qualities), such as shyness
Participants identified their own personality type and explored the implications.
The characters' names reflect their personalities.
There are likely to be tensions and personality clashes in any social group.
People’s clothes are often an expression of their personality.

senses.definition_vi: các khía cạnh khác nhau trong tính cách của một người kết hợp lại để làm cho họ khác biệt với những người khác

senses.definition: the qualities of a person’s character that make them interesting and attractive

examples.x: We need someone with lots of personality to head the project.

senses.definition_vi: những phẩm chất trong tính cách của một người khiến họ trở nên thú vị và hấp dẫn

senses.definition: a famous person, especially one who works in entertainment or sport

examples.x: a well-known TV/radio/sports personality
Various personalities from the world of music were invited.

senses.definition_vi: một người nổi tiếng, đặc biệt là người làm trong lĩnh vực giải trí hoặc thể thao

senses.definition: a person whose strong character attracts attention

examples.x: Their son is a real personality.

senses.definition_vi: một người có tính cách mạnh mẽ thu hút sự chú ý

senses.definition: the qualities of a place or thing that make it interesting and different

examples.x: The problem with many modern buildings is that they lack personality.
Interesting displays can add personality to your store window.

senses.definition_vi: những phẩm chất của một địa điểm hoặc sự vật làm cho nó trở nên thú vị và khác biệt

senses.definition: used to show that you are giving your own opinion about something

examples.x: Personally, I prefer the second option.
‘Is it worth the effort?’ ‘Speaking personally, yes.’
I personally think it would be the wrong thing to do.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra rằng bạn đang đưa ra ý kiến của riêng mình về điều gì đó

senses.definition: by a particular person rather than by somebody acting for them

examples.x: All emails will be answered personally.
Do you know him personally (= have you met him, rather than just knowing about him from other people)?
I’ll deal with the matter personally.
He’s no longer personally involved in the day-to-day running of the company.
He did not benefit personally from the fraud.
I have never personally witnessed public violence.

senses.definition_vi: do một người cụ thể thực hiện thay vì do người đại diện cho họ

senses.definition: in a way that is connected with one particular person rather than a group of people

examples.x: He was personally criticized by inspectors for his incompetence.
You will be held personally responsible for any loss or breakage.

senses.definition_vi: theo cách liên quan đến một người cụ thể thay vì một nhóm người

senses.definition: in a way that is intended to be offensive

examples.x: I'm sure she didn't mean it personally.

senses.definition_vi: theo cách có ý định xúc phạm

senses.definition: in a way that is connected with somebody’s personal life rather than with their job or official position

examples.x: Have you had any dealings with any of the suspects, either personally or professionally?

senses.definition_vi: theo cách liên quan đến đời sống cá nhân của ai đó thay vì công việc hoặc vị trí chính thức của họ

senses.definition: to be offended by something

examples.x: I'm afraid he took your remarks personally.
Please don’t take this personally, but would you mind leaving us alone for a few moments?

senses.definition_vi: bị xúc phạm bởi điều gì đó

senses.definition: a person who is the first to study and develop a particular area of knowledge, culture, etc. that other people then continue to develop

examples.x: a pioneer in the field of microsurgery
a computer pioneer
a pioneer aviator
a pioneer design (= one that introduces new ideas, methods, etc.)

senses.definition_vi: khi ai đó tiên phong một cái gì đó, họ là một trong những người đầu tiên làm, khám phá hoặc sử dụng một cái gì đó mới.

senses.definition: one of the first people to go to a particular place, especially in order to live and work there

examples.x: Early pioneers settled on both sides of the Maple River.
the pioneer spirit
The history of our nation isn't just about hardy pioneers and peaceful settlement, it's about violence and dispossession.
The space pioneer became the oldest person to go into space at the age of 82.

senses.definition_vi: khi ai đó tiên phong một cái gì đó, họ là một trong những người đầu tiên làm, khám phá hoặc sử dụng một cái gì đó mới.

senses.definition: having or showing good manners and respect for the feelings of others

examples.x: Please be polite to our guests.
Our waiter was very polite and helpful.
We were all too polite to object.

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc thể hiện phong thái tốt và tôn trọng cảm xúc của người khác

senses.definition: socially correct but not always sincere

examples.x: I don't know how to make polite conversation.
The performance was greeted with polite applause.
She greeted me with a quick hello and a polite smile.

senses.definition_vi: đúng mực về mặt xã hội nhưng không phải lúc nào cũng chân thành

senses.definition: from a class of society that believes it is better than others

examples.x: ‘Bum’ is not a word we use in polite company.
The scandal outraged polite society.

senses.definition_vi: từ một tầng lớp xã hội tin rằng mình hơn người khác

senses.definition: words that show that you approve of and admire somebody/something

examples.x: The team coach singled out two players for special praise.
His teachers are full of praise for the progress he's making.
His latest movie has won high praise from the critics.
He received widespread praise for his performance from fans on social media.
Critics heaped/lavished/showered praise on her latest movie.
to deserve/earn/garner praise
We have nothing but praise for the way they handled the investigation.
She wrote poems in praise of freedom.
She left with their praises ringing in her ears.
They always sing his praises (= praise him very highly).

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng bạn chấp thuận và ngưỡng mộ ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: the expression of thanks to or respect for God

examples.x: hymns/songs of praise
joyous singing and praise to God
Praise be (to God)! (= expressing belief or joy)

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng bạn chấp thuận và ngưỡng mộ ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to praise somebody/something only a little, in order to show that you do not really like them/it
senses.definition_vi: nói rằng bạn chấp thuận và ngưỡng mộ ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: a feeling of being pleased or satisfied that you get when you or people who are connected with you have done something well or own something that other people admire

examples.x: The sight of her son graduating filled her with pride.
He felt a glow of pride as people stopped to admire his garden.
Success in sport is a source of national pride.
I take (a) pride in my work.
They have a strong sense of pride in their work.
Their reputation for fairness is a matter of pride.
We take great pride in offering the best service in town.
I looked with pride at what I had achieved.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác hài lòng hoặc mãn nguyện mà bạn có được khi bạn hoặc những người có liên quan đến bạn đã làm tốt điều gì đó hoặc sở hữu thứ gì đó mà người khác ngưỡng mộ

senses.definition: a person or thing that makes people feel pleased or satisfied

examples.x: The new sports stadium is the pride of the town.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật khiến mọi người cảm thấy hài lòng hoặc mãn nguyện

senses.definition: the feeling of respect that you have for yourself

examples.x: Pride would not allow him to accept the money.
Her pride was hurt.
Losing his job was a real blow to his pride.
It's time to swallow your pride (= hide your feelings of pride) and ask for your job back.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác tôn trọng mà bạn dành cho bản thân

senses.definition: the feeling that you are better or more important than other people

examples.x: She was full of pride and arrogance and despised ordinary people.
His male pride would not let him admit that a woman had defeated him.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác rằng bạn tốt hơn hoặc quan trọng hơn những người khác

senses.definition: a group of lions

examples.x: This pride of lions is/are resting after a hunt.

senses.definition_vi: một nhóm sư tử

senses.definition: a person or thing that causes somebody to feel very pleased or satisfied

examples.x: The car is her pride and joy.
He loves that boat—it's his pride and joy.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật khiến ai đó cảm thấy rất hài lòng hoặc mãn nguyện

senses.definition: if you have too high an opinion of yourself or your abilities, something will happen to make you look stupid
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn có ý kiến quá cao về bản thân hoặc khả năng của mình, điều gì đó sẽ xảy ra để khiến bạn trông ngớ ngẩn

senses.definition: the position in which something is most easily seen, that is given to the most important thing in a particular group

examples.x: The photo was given pride of place on the mantelpiece.

senses.definition_vi: vị trí mà một thứ gì đó dễ nhìn thấy nhất, được trao cho thứ quan trọng nhất trong một nhóm cụ thể

senses.definition: having lived or existed for only a short time; not fully developed

examples.x: Young babies need to be wrapped up warmly.
a young country
Caterpillars eat the young leaves of this plant.
It's a young wine, not really up to drinking yet.
The night is still young (= it has only just started).
Small businesses, especially young ones, tend to operate on a tight budget.

senses.definition_vi: những người trẻ được xem như một nhóm.

senses.definition: not yet old; not as old as others

examples.x: young people
They sent many young men and women off to war.
My son's thirteen but he's young for his age (= not as developed as other boys of the same age).
I'm too young to remember much about the 1990s.
They married young (= at an early age).
My mother died young.
She looks much younger than her 39 years.
I don't know how families with young children manage to cope.
a young girl/boy/adult/person
In his younger days he played rugby for Wales.
I am the youngest of four sisters.
talented young football players
I met the young Michelle Obama at Princeton.
Her grandchildren keep her young (= keep her feeling young).

senses.definition_vi: những người trẻ được xem như một nhóm.

senses.definition: consisting of young people or young children; with a low average age

examples.x: They have a young family.
a young audience
This cottage would be perfect for a couple with a young family.

senses.definition_vi: những người trẻ được xem như một nhóm.

senses.definition: suitable or appropriate for young people

examples.x: young fashion
The clothes she wears are much too young for her.

senses.definition_vi: những người trẻ được xem như một nhóm.

senses.definition: used to show that you are angry or annoyed with a particular young person

examples.x: I think you owe me an apology, young lady!

senses.definition_vi: những người trẻ được xem như một nhóm.

senses.definition: used before or after a person’s name to show the difference between them and an older relative

examples.x: the younger Kennedy
William Pitt the younger

senses.definition_vi: những người trẻ được xem như một nhóm.

senses.definition: used to say that people seem to be doing something at a younger age than they used to, or that they seem younger because you are now older

examples.x: The band's fans are getting younger.
Why do police officers seem to be getting younger?

senses.definition_vi: những người trẻ được xem như một nhóm.

senses.definition: used when you are commenting that time is passing and that you are growing older

examples.x: We need to start thinking about our retirement. We’re not getting any younger, you know.

senses.definition_vi: những người trẻ được xem như một nhóm.

senses.definition: used to describe a young person who acts in a more sensible way than you would expect for a person of their age
senses.definition_vi: những người trẻ được xem như một nhóm.

senses.definition: thinking and behaving like a young person even when you are old

examples.x: My father is 76 but he’s still young at heart.
He's over 70, but he's young at heart.

senses.definition_vi: những người trẻ được xem như một nhóm.

senses.definition: young people should enjoy themselves as much as possible, because they will have to work and worry later in their lives
senses.definition_vi: những người trẻ được xem như một nhóm.

senses.definition: a young person or a child

examples.x: The camp is for youngsters aged 8 to 14.

senses.definition_vi: một người trẻ hoặc một đứa trẻ.

senses.definition: the time of life when a person is young, especially the time before a child becomes an adult

examples.x: He had been a talented musician in his youth.
She regrets that she spent her youth travelling and not studying.
to relive/recapture your youth
He joked that being good at cards was the sign of a misspent youth (= having wasted his time when he was young).

senses.definition_vi: giai đoạn cuộc đời khi một người còn trẻ, đặc biệt là giai đoạn trước khi một đứa trẻ trở thành người lớn.

senses.definition: the quality or state of being young

examples.x: She brings to the job a rare combination of youth and experience.
His youth gives him an advantage over the other runners.

senses.definition_vi: phẩm chất hoặc trạng thái của sự trẻ trung.

senses.definition: young people considered as a group

examples.x: the nation’s youth
Many people think the youth of today are not taught proper standards of behaviour.
training for unemployed youth
an increase in youth unemployment
contemporary youth culture
a youth worker (= somebody who works with young people)
Youth and adults tend to see things very differently.

senses.definition_vi: những người trẻ được xem như một nhóm.

senses.definition: a young man

examples.x: The fight was started by a gang of youths.

senses.definition_vi: một thanh niên.
